description.text:
The first set of the Black & White series and of the fifth generation, released on 25 April 2011 with 115 cards: 114 and a secret Pikachu. Only Pokémon from Unova appear in it, more than 70 of them new, among them Snivy, Tepig and Oshawott, and its Reshiram and Zekrom were the game's first full-art cards, with artwork covering the whole card. Its three theme decks, Green Tornado, Red Frenzy and Blue Assault, each came with a code for the same deck in the new online game.

It reorganised the game: Pokémon gained Abilities, which work much like Poké-Bodies, every non-Pokémon card other than Energy became a Trainer, split into Items, Supporters and Stadiums, and the cards were numbered by type and then in Pokédex order.
